paper_title: Constraints on hidden photons produced in nuclear reactors
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, plotted as Log10 epsilon
notes: Reactor-production hidden photon (dark photon) search, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies. Limits are on kinetic mixing epsilon vs mX from reanalysis of TEXONO data (Fig. 1), 95% CL. No numerical table is provided; the exclusion curve was reconstructed approximately from the text: for mX >~ 20 eV the limit is ~1.4e-5 (slightly weaker than Park's ~1e-5 due to a factor-4 signal correction and eps^4 dependence), and for mX < 20 eV sensitivity degrades roughly as eps ~ 1.4e-5*(20 eV/mX)^2 since the production and detection probabilities each scale as (mX/mgamma)^4, becoming insensitive below ~0.05 eV.
